_comment: Windsurf (Cascade) → hosted OmniMind MCP. File: ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json (or Windsurf → Settings → Cascade → MCP → Configure), then Refresh in the MCP panel. Windsurf uses `serverUrl` (not `url`) for a remote Streamable HTTP server and sends the static header on every request. The file is global only (no per-project config) and has no environment-variable interpolation, so the token sits here in plain text — prefer a read-mostly token. Token: BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools (omt_…). Windsurf caps the total tool count at 100 across all servers; OmniMind contributes 20. Add a .windsurfrules line 'Start with status_get; log decisions with decision_log' for the freshness contract (docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §8).
